summary: Initial run found deletion committed before validating the default pointer (4 pass/1 fail); recorded after the operation lock released. Builder preflight fix now passes the unchanged killer; follow-up approval will resolve this finding.
plainSummary: Deleting a workflow can report failure after the workflow has already disappeared.

findings.gap: deleteWorkflowProfile removes the record before defaultWorkflowProfileId validates pointer storage. A symlink pointer throws only after deletion.
findings.plainImpact: A rejected delete can still erase a saved workflow, leaving the user with a misleading failure and lost data.
findings.fixProposal: Validate and prepare all pointer handling before deleting the profile; reject unsafe or malformed pointer storage without deleting the record.

evidence.citedTest: packages/ledger/src/workflows/library-storage.break.test.ts::a refused delete with an unsafe default pointer preserves the saved workflow
evidence.observedOutput: AssertionError: a rejected operation must not delete the profile; false !== true; 4 pass, 1 fail

residualRisks: Bounded hunt: partial failure, local route poison/cross-site, storage confinement, and actual CLI/MCP retries and stale versions.
